name: M2 Bradley IFV
identity: Supplied m2-bradley-ifv.zip (m2_bradley.FBX + 2K maps): "M2 Bradley IFV" by 42manako, CC-BY-4.0, https://skfb.ly/py7tV (LIC3): M2 Bradley with the 25 mm M242 Bushmaster, coax M240C and the TOW launcher. Converted by E:/nmk/vh7scripts/convert_bradley.py (hull / turret / gun / track; the barrel split off the turret by its loose parts). The bake is committed (models/bradley); without it the Abrams mesh stands in.

rig.note: measured on the baked parts: barrel x -0.18..-0.06, y 2.46..2.58, z 0.76..2.36; turret basket z -1.8..0.88; TOW box on the turret's left; commander's hatch right rear

gun.name: 25 mm M242 Bushmaster
gun.note: VH7: automatic 25 mm at ~200 rpm (a 0.3 s loader cycle while LMB is held), AP / HE selectable (R). HE: a small blast per round; AP hurts light armour and the sides / rear of tanks a little (lightAP per hit), never a tank's front

ammunition.note: 300 ready rounds split AP / HE (the user's reference read-out: HE 0189 / 190)

bowMg.name: M240C coax (7.62 mm)
bowMg.note: coax: rides on the gun (no traverse of its own)

tow.name: BGM-71 TOW
tow.note: VH7: Q fires one; wire-guided toward the crosshair (turns at most turnDegPerS); 14 s to reload the pair one by one

durability.note: between an APC and a tank: small arms do nothing; a tank shell or AT rocket from any side: two from the front kill it, one from the side or rear

ramming.note: M2A2 combat mass, Cummins VTA-903T (600 hp)
